archetypes.name: dyn-cursor-degraded-calibration
archetypes.rationale: This PR adds a Cursor input-work-floor degraded backstop and inlines plan content for Cursor; the regression risk is mis-flagging legitimate clean reviews and breaking Codex or large-plan rendering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Scrutinize the new Cursor degraded-response backstop in python/agents.py (_review_cursor_write_result, _cursor_input_work_tokens, _cursor_output_tokens, _review_cursor_result_is_no_issues, floor _CURSOR_NO_WORK_INPUT_TOKEN_FLOOR=64) and the vendor-conditional plan inlining in python/rendering.py (_plan_review_plan_directive). Verify the input-work floor cannot mis-flag a genuine clean Cursor review, which returns the same bare {"no_issues_found": true} sentinel, including when usage is missing/zero or reported only as cacheReadTokens. Confirm Codex still receives the plan-file path while Cursor inlining preserves the untrusted-plan trust boundary and does not break on large plans or plan content containing braces or triple quotes. Check that the WI2 auth change (cursor_auth_preflight reading with -w and failing closed, cursor_preread_service_token surfacing failures) has no TOCTOU or non-Darwin regression and stays consistent with the launcher parity rule. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
